_comment: Registry for emu/play.sh. The manager fills in each game's verified disk image. Paths are relative to the repo root.

narrowscreen.title: Narrow Screen test disk (System 6.0 + Narrow Screen)
narrowscreen.controls: Mouse. Apple menu > Control Panel > Narrow Screen to adjust margins.

racer.title: Endurance
racer.controls: Mouse steers, button accelerates (or A/D steer, W/Space gas, S brake; arrows/X/Z also work). Return starts, P pauses, M sound on/off, Esc back to title / quit.

runner.title: Rail Runner
runner.controls: A/D: change lanes, W: jump, S: roll, Space: hoverboard (arrow keys work too). Return: start. M: sound on/off. Esc: back to the title, or quit from the title.

doodle.title: Doodle (paint + Finish it)
doodle.controls: Mouse. Draw inside the dotted frame, click Finish it (Cmd-F), type what it is (e.g. cat), press Return; click to stop, Undo removes it. Finish menu: Tidy / Normal / Wild.

pixel.title: Pixel the chatbot
pixel.controls: Type a message and press Return. Pixel reads its replies aloud when MacinTalk is in the System Folder (File > Speak Replies). It takes about 80 s to load in the emulator.

pixel_se.title: Pixel the chatbot (Macintosh SE, System 7, hard disk)
pixel_se.controls: Type a message and press Return, or use Edit > Keyboard… to type with the mouse.

blockworld.title: Blockworld
blockworld.status: ready (M7: starts at once in a ready-made world; New world in the Esc menu makes another in about a minute)
blockworld.controls: Mouse looks, button mines and hits; W A S D move, Space jumps (or swims up), E places / uses / eats / shoots the bow, Shift+E places against a workbench, 1-9 pick the hotbar slot, Tab the inventory, V the view distance, Esc the menu (save and quit), M sound on/off.

blockworld_se.title: Blockworld (Macintosh SE, 1.44 MB floppy)
blockworld_se.status: ready (same game; System 6.0.7 SE boot floppy)

dream.title: Dream (tiny diffusion model, 4 MB)
dream.controls: Type a subject (e.g. house) and press Return, or click Dream; Return with an empty box or Surprise me picks one of 220. The picture develops from static in 6 steps (about 95 s on a real Plus); click to stop after the current step. File menu: Copy Picture, Save as MacPaint. Loads its model for about 55 s first.

dream_1mb.title: Dream (1 MB Plus, 32x32)
dream_1mb.controls: Same as Dream, at 32x32 with 191 subjects (about 48 s per picture on a real Plus).

dream_se.title: Dream (Macintosh SE, 1.44 MB floppy)
dream_se.status: ready (same app and model; System 6.0.7 SE boot floppy)
dream_se.controls: As Dream (about 85 s per picture on a real SE).

guess.title: Guess My Doodle
guess.controls: Mouse. Return (or the big button) starts a round; draw the word in the box within 20 s while the Mac guesses. Undo (Cmd-Z or Delete), Clear (Cmd-K), Skip. M sound on/off; File > Speak Guesses with MacinTalk; Esc back to the title, then quit.

guess_se.title: Guess My Doodle (Macintosh SE, 1.44 MB floppy)

tune.title: Tune
tune.status: ready (the Mac composes and plays folk tunes: reel, jig, hornpipe, waltz, march, air and more; 1 MB Plus)
tune.controls: Mouse: Compose, Again, Play/Stop, Save, Copy buttons; menus Tune (type), Key, Play (tempo, fiddle/flute, bass, sound). Return = Again (new tune), Space = Play/Stop, M = sound on/off, Esc = stop. File > Quit.

tune_se.title: Tune (Macintosh SE, 1.44 MB floppy)
tune_se.status: ready (same app; System 6.0.7 SE boot floppy)

calc.title: Scribble Calc (handwriting calculator)
calc.controls: Mouse: write a sum on the paper and end it with = (e.g. 12 x (3.5 + 4) =); a small raised number after a number is a power. Click a symbol under the paper to fix it. Return = new line, Delete = undo, E / P = eraser / pen, Cmd-C copies the answer, Esc quits.

calc_se.title: Scribble Calc (Macintosh SE, 1.44 MB floppy)
calc_se.status: ready (same app; System 6.0.7 SE boot floppy)

pinball.title: Neural Pinball
pinball.controls: A / D (or Z and /, or the arrows): flippers; Shift or the mouse button: both. Hold Space or S to pull the plunger, let go to launch. W (or Space in play): nudge (tilt!). Return: start (or a flipper key: take over the AI's ball). P: pause, M: sound, Esc: end the game / quit.

broadside.title: Broadside
broadside.status: ready (Easy / Normal / Hard; Options > Show the Mac's Thinking shades your grid with Hard's exact probabilities; Salvo and No Touching rules; record and statistics saved)
broadside.controls: Mouse. Drag a ship to move it, click it (or R) to turn it, Tab = random fleet, Return = start. Click a square in Enemy waters to fire (or W A S D / arrows to aim, Space to fire). T = show the Mac's thinking, M = sound, Esc = quit.

broadside_se.title: Broadside (Macintosh SE, 1.44 MB floppy)
broadside_se.status: ready (same game; System 6.0.7 SE boot floppy)

duel.title: Orbit Duel
duel.status: ready (vs the computer, two players on one keyboard, or Mac to Mac over a serial cable or AppleTalk; serial lockstep verified Plus-Plus and Plus-SE in MAME; two-Mac AppleTalk untested, MAME has no LocalTalk)
duel.controls: A/D turn, W thrust, Space or Shift fire, S hyperspace (arrows also work). Return pauses, M sound, Esc back to the title / quit. Title: 1 vs computer, 2 two players (Needle W A S D + Space/Option/Command, Wedge I J K L or arrows + Shift/Enter), 3 AppleTalk, 4 serial cable; Tab = computer level.

duel_se.title: Orbit Duel (Macintosh SE, 1.44 MB floppy)
duel_se.status: ready (same game; System 6.0.7 SE boot floppy with the Chooser)

tanks.title: Tank Duel
tanks.controls: W/S drive, A/D turn the hull, the mouse aims the turret, click (or Space / Shift) fires. Return or P pauses, Tab shows the AI's sensors, M sound, Esc back to the title / quit. Options menu: Sound, Show the AI, Easy / Normal / Hard.

tanks_se.title: Tank Duel (Macintosh SE, 1.44 MB floppy)
tanks_se.status: ready (same game; System 6.0.7 SE boot floppy)

askai.title: Ask AI (chat with AI models through a Wi-Fi modem)
askai.status: ready (needs the relay and a Hayes Wi-Fi modem; in the emulator it shows its welcome note)
askai.controls: Type a message, Return. Connection > Settings… / Connect (Cmd-K) / Modem Terminal; Model menu; File > New Chat; Cmd-. stops a reply.

askai_se.title: Ask AI (Macintosh SE, 1.44 MB floppy)
askai_se.status: ready (needs the relay and a Hayes Wi-Fi modem; in the emulator it shows its welcome note)
askai_se.controls: Type a message, Return. Connection > Settings… / Connect (Cmd-K) / Modem Terminal; Model menu; File > New Chat; Cmd-. stops a reply.

shuttle.title: Plus Modem disk (Shuttle file transfer + Ask AI; needs the Wi-Fi modem and the Shuttle server)
shuttle.status: ready (needs the Shuttle server on the MacBook and the Wi-Fi modem; in the emulator it starts at the Finder)
shuttle.controls: Finder: double-click Plus Modem, then Shuttle or Ask AI. Shuttle: Connect (Cmd-K), double-click folders, Download (Cmd-D), Send File (Cmd-U), Cmd-. cancels; Connection > Settings / Modem Terminal.
